representativeSnapshot.kind: Supabase project with promoter Phases 1-6 applied

rowCountQueries: promoter memberships by user and program status
attribution, ledger, payout allocation, touchpoint, link, and promo-code counts by membership
verify no client role has raw ticket_sale_attributions read access
preflight.expectedAffectedRows: Creates read-only dashboard functions only. It does not create, update, or delete financial, attribution, payment, or payout rows.

execution.resumeStrategy: Functions are replaceable and idempotent. No historical rows are backfilled or changed.
execution.idempotency: The dashboard has no write path. Every result derives its membership scope from auth.uid() inside the private definer function.

quarantine.strategy: If read-model output is unexpected, disable the promoter program flag and forward-fix the function. Do not alter ledger history.

constraints: The exposed RPC has no user or membership parameter and cannot select another promoter's data
The private security-definer helper is outside the exposed schema and derives the owner from auth.uid()
Raw payment references are represented only as a boolean in the ledger result
Financial totals are grouped by currency and are computed directly from append-only ledger rows
indexes: Uses existing membership, ledger, attribution, touchpoint, link, promo-code-binding, and payout-allocation indexes
constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Call the RPC as promoter A, promoter B, and an unauthenticated role. Confirm only the calling promoter's memberships/assets/ledger are returned; compare every currency total to raw promoter_commission_ledger aggregation; confirm no values contain a payment reference or tracking token hash.

recovery.rollback: Disable event_promoter_program_enabled to hide the workspace. The migration has no mutable data to roll back.
recovery.forwardFix: Replace the private/public read functions in an additive migration after preserving the membership-scoped and server-derived contract.

queries: private.get_my_event_promoter_earnings_dashboard is not exposed through the Data API
promoter A cannot obtain promoter B's ledger or assets
dashboard earned/reversed/pending/available/paid totals reconcile to promoter_commission_ledger by currency
